items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Now, was Pete Briggs there when you were there? [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: Because I have a picture here of the Blue Rhythm Band, which is quite early. And it has Carroll Dickerson fronting the band. But at this point, now, when you came in with the Blue Rhythm Band, the pianist was Edgar Hayes.
Okay. There's Carroll Dickerson. That's Willie Lynch on drums. That's Briggs.
